Title: Child of God
Meaning: Through faith in Christ, believers receive power to become sons and daughters of God, with the Spirit bearing witness that they are his children.
PracticalChange: You approach God as a Father, not a stranger, and you belong to his household.

Title: New Creation
Meaning: If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away and all things are become new.
PracticalChange: Your past does not define you; your life is rebuilt around Christ, not around old patterns.

Title: Chosen
Meaning: God chose believers in Christ before the foundation of the world, that they should be holy and without blame before him in love.
PracticalChange: Your standing with God rests on his choice, not on your performance on any given day.

Title: Adopted
Meaning: Believers have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby they cry Abba, Father, and are no longer servants but sons.
PracticalChange: You have a permanent place in God's family, with the rights and access of a son or daughter.

Title: Redeemed
Meaning: Believers are redeemed from sin and the curse of the law, bought back not with silver or gold but with the precious blood of Christ.
PracticalChange: You are no longer owned by sin or guilt; you were bought at a price and belong to Christ.

Title: Forgiven
Meaning: In Christ believers have forgiveness of sins according to the riches of God's grace, and are commanded to forgive one another as God forgave them.
PracticalChange: Guilt is answered, not carried; and forgiveness received becomes forgiveness extended.

Title: Saint (Holy One)
Meaning: Believers are called saints — holy ones set apart to God — not because they are sinless, but because God has sanctified them in Christ.
PracticalChange: Holiness is your identity before it is your achievement, which is why pursuing it is not pretending.

Title: Heir and Joint-Heir With Christ
Meaning: As children of God, believers are heirs of God and joint-heirs with Christ, sharing in his inheritance and, if they suffer with him, in his glory.
PracticalChange: Your future is an inheritance kept for you, not wages you must earn.

Title: Ambassador for Christ
Meaning: Believers are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech men by them, entrusted with the ministry and word of reconciliation.
PracticalChange: You represent Christ where you live and work, speaking and acting on his behalf.

Title: Temple of the Holy Spirit
Meaning: Believers, individually and together, are the temple of God, and the Spirit of God dwells in them.
PracticalChange: How you treat your body and your brothers and sisters matters, because God dwells there.

Title: More Than Conquerors
Meaning: In all tribulation, distress, persecution, and peril, believers are more than conquerors through him that loved them, and nothing separates them from God's love.
PracticalChange: Hardship does not mean God has left you; victory is measured by his love holding, not by trouble disappearing.

Title: Royal Priesthood
Meaning: Believers are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a peculiar people, called to show forth the praises of him who called them out of darkness.
PracticalChange: You have direct access to God and a part in his worship and witness, not second-hand religion.

Title: Holy Nation and Peculiar People
Meaning: Believers together are God's own people, purchased and set apart to be his, distinct from the world in allegiance and conduct.
PracticalChange: You belong to a people before you belong to any tribe, party, or nation.

Title: Member of Christ's Body
Meaning: Believers are members of the body of Christ, each with a part, joined to Christ the head and to one another.
PracticalChange: You are needed where God placed you, and you need the other members as much as they need you.

Title: Branch in the Vine
Meaning: Christ is the true vine and believers are the branches; abiding in him, they bear fruit, and apart from him they can do nothing.
PracticalChange: Fruitfulness comes from staying close to Christ, not from straining harder on your own.

Title: Friend of Christ
Meaning: Jesus calls his disciples friends, not servants, because he has made known to them all things he heard of his Father.
PracticalChange: Obedience to Christ is friendship, not mere duty; he tells his friends what he is doing.

Title: Brother and Sister of Christ
Meaning: Christ is not ashamed to call believers brethren, having been made like them and sanctified by the same Father.
PracticalChange: You share Christ's family standing; his Father is your Father.

Title: Citizen of Heaven
Meaning: Believers' citizenship is in heaven, from whence they look for the Saviour, though they live as strangers and pilgrims on earth.
PracticalChange: Your deepest loyalty and final home are elsewhere, which frees you from needing this world to be heaven.

Title: Salt and Light
Meaning: Believers are the salt of the earth and the light of the world, called to preserve good and to shine before men so that the Father is glorified.
PracticalChange: Ordinary faithfulness where you are is itself witness; hiding it helps no one.

Title: God's Workmanship
Meaning: Believers are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God prepared beforehand that they should walk in them.
PracticalChange: Your life has prepared purpose; good works are the path, not the price of acceptance.

Title: Sealed With the Spirit
Meaning: Believers are sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise, the earnest of their inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession.
PracticalChange: God has marked you as his own, and the Spirit in you is the down payment of what is to come.

Title: Justified
Meaning: Believers are justified freely by God's grace through faith in Christ, counted righteous, and at peace with God.
PracticalChange: You stand before God acquitted, not on probation.

Title: Sanctified
Meaning: Believers are sanctified in Christ Jesus, washed and set apart, and are being made holy by the one offering of Christ.
PracticalChange: Growth in holiness is God finishing what he started, not you earning your place.

Title: Free
Meaning: Believers are made free by the truth and by the Son, freed from the law of sin and death, and called to stand fast in that liberty.
PracticalChange: Freedom means serving in love, not returning to bondage or using liberty as a cover for sin.

Title: Alive in Christ
Meaning: Believers, once dead in trespasses and sins, are quickened together with Christ and raised up together, seated in heavenly places in him.
PracticalChange: You live a new life now, reckoning yourself dead to sin and alive to God.

Title: Beloved
Meaning: Believers are beloved of God, accepted in the Beloved, and loved with the love the Father has for the Son.
PracticalChange: You are loved before you perform and after you fail; that is the ground of obedience, not its reward.

Title: Servant of Christ
Meaning: Believers are servants of Jesus Christ, bought and owned by him, whose service is freedom rather than bondage.
PracticalChange: Your work, whatever it is, is done for Christ as your master, not for men's approval.

Title: Soldier of Christ
Meaning: Believers endure hardness as good soldiers of Jesus Christ, putting on the whole armour of God to stand against spiritual opposition.
PracticalChange: Expect opposition and stand firm, without entangling yourself in the affairs of this life.

Title: Under No Condemnation
Meaning: There is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus, and believers will not come into condemnation, because judgment for their sin fell on Christ.
PracticalChange: You stop living under a verdict God has already lifted, and you face failures with repentance instead of dread.

Title: Reconciled to God
Meaning: Through Christ, God reconciled believers to himself, turning former enemies into friends and entrusting them with the message of reconciliation.
PracticalChange: You relate to God as a friend, not an enemy, and you carry that same welcome to others.

Title: Righteousness of God in Christ
Meaning: Christ was made sin for believers so that they might be made the righteousness of God in him; his righteousness, not their own, is their standing.
PracticalChange: You stand before God in Christ's righteousness, not in a record you must keep earning.

Title: Crucified With Christ
Meaning: Believers were crucified with Christ: the old self was put to death with him, so that sin no longer rules them and Christ lives in them.
PracticalChange: You treat old patterns as dead, not as masters, and you live by faith in the Son of God.

Title: Born Again
Meaning: Believers are born again, not of corruptible seed but of incorruptible, by the word of God; the new birth begins their life as God's children.
PracticalChange: Your spiritual life has a real beginning, and growth follows from that birth rather than from self-improvement alone.

Title: Hidden With Christ in God
Meaning: Believers have died, and their life is hidden with Christ in God, kept safe with him until he appears in glory.
PracticalChange: Your deepest life is kept with Christ, not exposed to every opinion or circumstance.

Title: Raised and Seated With Christ
Meaning: God raised believers up together with Christ and made them sit together in heavenly places in him, sharing his risen and exalted position.
PracticalChange: You live from a raised position, looking at earthly troubles from where Christ already reigns.

Title: Complete in Christ
Meaning: Believers are complete in Christ, who is the head of all principality and power; nothing outside him needs to be added to make them whole.
PracticalChange: You stop hunting for a missing piece to complete you, and you rest in what Christ already supplies.

Title: Clothed With Christ
Meaning: As many as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ, wearing him the way a garment is worn, so that he covers and identifies them.
PracticalChange: You present yourself to the world in Christ's name and character, not in your old reputation.

Title: One in Christ
Meaning: In Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek, bond nor free, male nor female; believers are all one in him, and the dividing wall between them is broken down.
PracticalChange: You treat every fellow believer as family, whatever their background, because Christ made you one.

Title: Seed of Abraham
Meaning: Those who are of faith are Abraham's children, and all who belong to Christ are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.
PracticalChange: You belong to a promise older than your own story, and you inherit it by faith, not by ancestry.

Title: Grafted Into the Olive Tree
Meaning: Gentile believers, a wild olive tree, were grafted in among the natural branches to share the root and fatness of God's olive tree.
PracticalChange: You stand in a story you did not start, supported by a root you did not plant.

Title: Delivered From Darkness Into the Kingdom
Meaning: The Father delivered believers from the power of darkness and translated them into the kingdom of his dear Son.
PracticalChange: You no longer live under darkness as your ruler; your citizenship changed when you came to Christ.

Title: Living Stones
Meaning: Believers come to Christ, the living stone, as lively stones themselves, built up into a spiritual house for a holy priesthood.
PracticalChange: You have a place in something being built, not just a private faith; your life fits with others into God's house.

Title: Sheep of the Good Shepherd
Meaning: Believers are the sheep of the good shepherd, who laid down his life for them; they hear his voice and follow him, and they shall never perish.
PracticalChange: You follow one voice above the noise, trusting the shepherd who already died for you.

Title: Bride of Christ
Meaning: The church is presented to Christ as a bride, espoused to one husband and made ready for the marriage of the Lamb.
PracticalChange: You belong to Christ with the closeness and faithfulness of a marriage, not a casual arrangement.

Title: Disciple of Christ
Meaning: A disciple is one who learns from Christ, abides in his word, takes up his cross daily, and follows him.
PracticalChange: Your daily life is a school under one teacher, and following him shapes your choices.

Title: Anointed
Meaning: Believers have an unction from the Holy One, and the anointing they received abides in them and teaches them.
PracticalChange: You are not left to guess at God's truth; his anointing rests on you and guides you.

Title: Accepted in the Beloved
Meaning: God made believers accepted in the Beloved, receiving them with favour in Christ and making their service acceptable to him.
PracticalChange: You come to God already received, not waiting to become acceptable first.

Title: Kings and Priests
Meaning: Christ washed believers from their sins and made them kings and priests unto God, to reign on the earth, and those who receive the gift of righteousness reign in life by him.
PracticalChange: You serve God as a priest and you live with a king's dignity, because Christ gave you both.

Title: Partakers of the Divine Nature
Meaning: Through God's great and precious promises, believers are partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
PracticalChange: Your new life shares in God's own nature, not merely in better habits.

Title: Partakers of the Heavenly Calling
Meaning: Believers are holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, called with a holy calling and pressing toward the prize of the high calling of God in Christ.
PracticalChange: Your life has a calling from heaven on it, and your daily work answers to that call.

Title: Strangers and Pilgrims
Meaning: Believers confess that they are strangers and pilgrims on the earth, sojourners whose true home is elsewhere, and they seek a better country.
PracticalChange: You hold this world lightly, because your home is ahead of you, not behind you.

Title: Vessel of Honour
Meaning: If a man purge himself from dishonourable ways, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified and meet for the master's use, prepared unto every good work.
PracticalChange: You keep yourself clean and ready, because God uses clean vessels for good work.

Title: Firstfruits of God's Creatures
Meaning: Of his own will God begat believers with the word of truth, that they should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
PracticalChange: Your life is a first taste of what God is making new in all creation.

Title: Living Letters of Christ
Meaning: Believers are the epistle of Christ, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, known and read of all men.
PracticalChange: People read Christ in your life before they read him in a book, so your conduct is a letter.

Title: Fragrance of Christ
Meaning: Believers are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, a fragrance that makes Christ known wherever they go.
PracticalChange: Your presence carries something of Christ with it, whether people welcome it or not.

Title: Pillar of Truth
Meaning: The church of the living God is the pillar and ground of the truth, holding up and displaying God's truth in the world.
PracticalChange: You stand for truth where God placed you, holding it up for others to see.

Title: Preserved in Jesus Christ
Meaning: Believers are sanctified by God the Father and preserved in Jesus Christ; no man can pluck them out of his hand, and nothing can separate them from the love of God.
PracticalChange: You rest in being kept, not in keeping yourself, because Christ holds you.

Title: Written in the Book of Life
Meaning: Believers' names are written in heaven, in the book of life, and they rejoice that their names are recorded there.
PracticalChange: Your name is already on heaven's roll, and that settles where you belong.

Title: One Spirit With the Lord
Meaning: He that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit; believers are united with Christ in a spiritual oneness that nothing else matches.
PracticalChange: Your union with Christ is as close as spirit with spirit, not a distant alliance.

Title: Made in God's Image
Meaning: God created man in his own image, and in Christ that image is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him.
PracticalChange: Your worth was stamped on you at creation and is being renewed in Christ.

Title: Fearfully and Wonderfully Made
Meaning: Believers confess that they are fearfully and wonderfully made, formed by God's own hand in the womb.
PracticalChange: You receive your own body and mind as God's careful work, not as an accident.

Title: Christian
Meaning: The disciples were called Christians first in Antioch, and believers bear the name of Christ, suffering if need be as Christians and glorifying God in it.
PracticalChange: You carry Christ's name openly, and that name, not any other label, defines you.

Title: Children of the Resurrection
Meaning: Those who are accounted worthy to obtain the resurrection from the dead are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection, and they cannot die any more.
PracticalChange: Your future is resurrection life, and that hope shapes how you face death now.

Title: Circumcised in Heart
Meaning: Believers are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh, and they worship God in the spirit.
PracticalChange: Your heart, not just your outward life, has been cut away from the old flesh.

Title: Overcomer
Meaning: Believers overcome the world by faith, and they overcome by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. Doubt: Overlaps More Than Conquerors (Romans 8:37), an existing entry.
PracticalChange: You face opposition as one who already overcomes, not as one hoping to.

Title: Risen With Christ
Meaning: Believers are risen with Christ through the faith of the operation of God, and they seek those things which are above. Doubt: Risen aspect already carried by Raised and Seated With Christ (Colossians 3:1) and Alive in Christ.
PracticalChange: You set your mind on things above, because your life rose with Christ.

Title: Rooted in Christ
Meaning: Believers are rooted and built up in Christ, and stablished in the faith, abounding with thanksgiving. Doubt: Overlaps Branch in the Vine (attachment and growth in Christ).
PracticalChange: You draw your stability from Christ the way a tree draws from its roots.

Title: Washed Clean
Meaning: Believers are washed, sanctified, and justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and washed from their sins in his own blood. Doubt: Overlaps Forgiven (pardon) and Sanctified (cleansing).
PracticalChange: You live as one made clean, not as one still stained by the old life.

Title: Ministers of Reconciliation
Meaning: God gave believers the ministry of reconciliation, committing to them the word of reconciliation. Doubt: Overlaps Ambassador for Christ, from the same passage and the same function.
PracticalChange: You carry the message that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself.

Title: Fellow Workers With God
Meaning: Believers are labourers together with God, working with him in what he is doing. Doubt: Role/commission rather than identity title; overlaps Servant of Christ.
PracticalChange: You work alongside God, not for him at a distance.

Title: God's Building and Field
Meaning: Believers are God's husbandry and God's building, the field he tills and the house he builds. Doubt: Overlaps Temple of the Holy Spirit and God's Workmanship.
PracticalChange: You grow under God's hand and you are built by him, not by yourself.

Title: Holy Temple and Dwelling of God
Meaning: Believers grow together into a holy temple in the Lord, built together for a habitation of God through the Spirit. Doubt: Corporate temple overlaps the individual Temple of the Holy Spirit entry.
PracticalChange: Together with other believers you form the place where God dwells.

Title: Members of God's Household
Meaning: Believers are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God. Doubt: Overlaps Child of God (family status).
PracticalChange: You belong inside God's household, not outside looking in.

Title: Brought Near by the Blood
Meaning: Believers who were sometimes far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. Doubt: Overlaps Reconciled to God, from the same chapter and the same movement.
PracticalChange: Distance from God is ended for you; Christ's blood brought you near.

Title: Bold Access to God
Meaning: Believers have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of Christ, and they may come boldly unto the throne of grace. Doubt: Privilege/access rather than identity title; overlaps Reconciled and Free.
PracticalChange: You approach God freely and confidently, not timidly.

Title: Children of Promise and of the Covenant
Meaning: Believers, as Isaac was, are the children of promise, and they are the children of the prophets and of the covenant God made with their fathers. Doubt: Overlaps Child of God and Seed of Abraham.
PracticalChange: Your place in God's family comes by promise, not by birth alone.

Title: Christ in You
Meaning: Christ in believers is the hope of glory; Christ lives in them, and the Spirit who lives in them is greater than he that is in the world. Doubt: Overlaps Temple of the Holy Spirit (indwelling) and Crucified With Christ.
PracticalChange: You carry Christ within you, and his presence is your hope.

Title: Glorified With Christ
Meaning: Those whom God justified, them he also glorified, and Christ gave believers the glory the Father gave him. Doubt: Future aspect; overlaps Heir (glory inheritance).
PracticalChange: Your story ends in glory with Christ, not in shame.

Title: Called Out of Darkness Into Light
Meaning: God called believers out of darkness into his marvellous light, and they were sometimes darkness but now are light in the Lord. Doubt: Composite of Called/Chosen and Salt and Light.
PracticalChange: You left darkness behind when God called you, and you walk as light now.

Title: Shown Mercy
Meaning: Believers who in time past had not obtained mercy have now obtained mercy. Doubt: Overlaps Forgiven.
PracticalChange: You live as one who received mercy you did not earn.

Title: Servants of Righteousness
Meaning: Being then made free from sin, believers became the servants of righteousness. Doubt: Overlaps Servant of Christ; a master-change statement.
PracticalChange: You serve a new master now, and righteousness is his name.

Title: Established in Christ
Meaning: God establishes believers in Christ, and anoints them, and seals them. Doubt: Overlaps Sealed With the Spirit, from the same verse cluster.
PracticalChange: You stand firm because God himself established you in Christ.

Title: Christ Our Wisdom, Righteousness, Sanctification, and Redemption
Meaning: Of God believers are in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto them wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption. Doubt: Composite; parts already covered by Righteousness of God in Christ, Sanctified, Redeemed.
PracticalChange: Everything you need before God, Christ himself supplies.

Title: Pillar in God's Temple
Meaning: Him that overcometh will Christ make a pillar in the temple of his God, and he shall go no more out. Doubt: Future reward image; overlaps Temple of the Holy Spirit.
PracticalChange: Your place in God's house is fixed and permanent.

Title: Guests at the Marriage Supper
Meaning: Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. Doubt: Future-feast role; overlaps Bride of Christ (same supper).
PracticalChange: You are invited to the Lamb's own feast, not left outside.

Title: Church of the Firstborn
Meaning: Believers are come to the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven. Doubt: Corporate assembly language; overlaps Citizen of Heaven.
PracticalChange: You belong to an assembly already enrolled in heaven.

Title: Lampstands of Christ
Meaning: The seven golden candlesticks are the seven churches, shining as lights where Christ placed them. Doubt: Corporate church symbol; overlaps Salt and Light (witness function).
PracticalChange: Together with your church you shine where Christ set you.

Title: Apple of His Eye
Meaning: The Lord kept his people as the apple of his eye, guarding them as the most tender and precious part. Doubt: Israel/Zion-specific origin; general application is devotional only.
PracticalChange: You are guarded by God as something tender and precious to him.

Title: Engraved on God's Hands
Meaning: Zion is graven upon the palms of God's hands, and her walls are continually before him. Doubt: Zion-specific; poetic image, not a general identity statement.
PracticalChange: You are never out of God's sight; he carries the mark of you on his hands.

Title: Spirit of Power, Love, and a Sound Mind
Meaning: God has not given believers the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. Doubt: Describes the Spirit given, not a status title; overlaps Sealed/Temple.
PracticalChange: Fear is not the spirit you received; power, love, and a sound mind are.

Title: Valued Above Many Sparrows
Meaning: Not one sparrow is forgotten before God, and believers are of more value than many sparrows; even the hairs of their head are numbered. Doubt: Care/worth statement rather than identity title.
PracticalChange: You matter to God in detail, down to the hairs of your head.

Title: Called
Meaning: Believers are the called of Jesus Christ, called to be saints, and called according to God's purpose. Doubt: Overlaps Chosen and Saint.
PracticalChange: Your life answers a call that came from God, not from yourself.

Title: Given by the Father to the Son
Meaning: Believers are those whom the Father gave to the Son, and all that the Father gives him shall come to him. Doubt: Describes the Father's giving; overlaps Chosen/Beloved.
PracticalChange: You came to Christ because the Father gave you to him.

Title: Children of the Kingdom
Meaning: The field is the world, and the good seed are the children of the kingdom. Doubt: Overlaps Citizen of Heaven.
PracticalChange: You are sown by God into his world as his own seed.

Title: Israel of God
Meaning: As many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God. Doubt: Debated identification; overlaps Holy Nation/Seed of Abraham.
PracticalChange: You walk under the rule of the new creation, counted among God's Israel.

Title: Peace With God
Meaning: Being justified by faith, believers have peace with God through the Lord Jesus Christ. Doubt: Overlaps Justified (same verse) and Reconciled.
PracticalChange: Your relationship with God is at peace, not at war.

Title: Citizens of the Heavenly Jerusalem
Meaning: Believers are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. Doubt: Overlaps Citizen of Heaven.
PracticalChange: Your city is the heavenly Jerusalem, and you already belong to it.

Title: White Stone and a New Name
Meaning: To him that overcometh Christ will give a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it. Doubt: Future reward, not present identity.
PracticalChange: You will receive a new name from Christ himself, known only to you and him.

Title: Partakers of Christ and of the Promise
Meaning: Believers are made partakers of Christ, if they hold fast, and fellowheirs and partakers of his promise in Christ. Doubt: Overlaps Member of Christ's Body / Seed of Abraham.
PracticalChange: You share in Christ himself and in the promise made to his people.

Title: Witnesses of Christ
Meaning: Believers shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon them, and they shall be witnesses unto Christ. Doubt: Commission/role rather than identity title; overlaps Ambassador.
PracticalChange: Your life testifies to Christ wherever you are sent.

Title: Stewards of God's Grace
Meaning: As every man has received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God. Doubt: Role; overlaps Servant of Christ.
PracticalChange: You manage God's grace for others, not only for yourself.

Title: Earthen Vessels
Meaning: Believers have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of them. Doubt: Overlaps Vessel of Honour (vessel family).
PracticalChange: Your weakness is the point: God's power shows through a plain vessel.

Title: Blessed With Every Spiritual Blessing
Meaning: God has blessed believers with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ. Doubt: Blessing inventory, not identity title.
PracticalChange: Every blessing you need in Christ is already yours in him.

Title: House of Christ
Meaning: Christ is a son over his own house, whose house are believers, if they hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end. Doubt: Overlaps Child of God and Members of God's Household.
PracticalChange: You are part of Christ's own house, under his care as Son.
